Close-out: 2026-11-24T11:45Z · area ux-C · landed by PR #36953 (merge `021271471173e51aaa102073d606002bf69da5cc`, head `6d5352daddc66b69880289bd7ab6346879306bb0`, L1 ACCEPT 7129955141). A related-list tab badge now follows the list after a row action. The measured cause was that a row action reaches the data-change bus twice, so the second invalidation overtook the first re-count. The store answered that overtaken read without caching it, and the badge reader took the answer as a failed read and never asked again. The store now marks overtaken reads and re-reads until it holds a count. A failure that was not overtaken still answers 0. Delete after a row action and create after a row action are both pinned and live-checked. A header (record-level) action was not checked in the browser; it goes through the same store path. `pm:dispatched` removed.
